title: GoldenEye 007
tagline: Bond, James Bond — 20 levels, three difficulties, 21 cheat times, and a split-screen cleanup.
order_note: In walkthrough order: story missions first, then the three difficulty completions, then the cheat time trials, then multiplayer. Play Agent first, then Secret Agent, then 00 Agent — difficulty does not stack, so each of the first 18 levels must be finished on each difficulty, and the level-select checkmarks alone don't prove a difficulty completion (check for a Best Time on the abort screen). Cheats can't be used to unlock other achievements. Multiplayer needs no online play and can be boosted split-screen with a single controller in about 45 minutes once single player is done.
scope_note: Full game: all 55 achievements / 1,000G — the Xbox re-release of the 1997 classic. No missables; about 15–20 hours across 3 playthroughs plus the multiplayer cleanup.

achievements.name: Unheroic
achievements.req: Kill a player while they're unarmed.

achievements.req: Score 100 kills in multiplayer matches over time.
achievements.how: Score 100 kills across matches — Licence to Kill (one-shot kills), Basement, Turbo Mode on. A second controller keeps respawns flowing; with one controller, repeat short matches.
